questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

Ritika closed the box quickly.

options.text: The box has been closed by Ritika quickly.
The box had closed quickly by Ritika.
The box is quickly closed by Ritika.
The box was closed by Ritika quickly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Ritika closed the box quickly."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the box" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "closed" to "was closed" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Ritika."
 
• Ensure the adverb "quickly" is placed appropriately for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The box was closed by Ritika quickly."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The box has been closed by Ritika quickly." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"The box had closed quickly by Ritika." – Incorrect structure and tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"The box is quickly closed by Ritika." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive).

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Bhavin said, 'I will take you now.'

options.text: Bhavin said that he will take you then.
Bhavin said that he has to take me now.
Bhavin said that he will be taking me then.
Bhavin said that he would take me then.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Bhavin said that he would take me then.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun and Tense Changes:**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the third-person perspective.
 
• Verb "will" is changed to "would" to match the past tense of reported speech.
 
• Adverb "now" is changed to "then" to match the time context in reported speech.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Bhavin said that he would take me then.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Bhavin said that he will take you then." 

 
 
• Incorrect future tense "will" in reported speech context.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Bhavin said that he has to take me now."
 
 
• Incorrect verb tense "has to" and time reference "now".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Bhavin said that he will be taking me then."
 
 
• Incorrect future continuous tense "will be taking".
